classification.reboot_occurred: CONFIRMED by changed kernel boot UUID and low positive uptime; original AA kernel process cannot survive a new kernel boot.
classification.reboot_cause: UNKNOWN. Operator reports no power interruption. Reviewer did not inspect private kernel/messages/watchdog bytes.
classification.old_RAM_closure: Positive public OLD_GUARD_RAM_ABSENT response; not proof that the old guard successfully executed its restore before reboot.
classification.original_AA_acceptance: NOT_ACCEPTED. New boot/runtime cannot satisfy the frozen original same-boot/network-restoration criterion.
classification.current_management_identity: Pinned direct path and exact identity are root-reported acquisition provenance; public identity/snapshot/MAC/version/hash contents were independently checked locally.

minimum_requalification_for_AB: Create a new versioned intake derived from the accepted original, preserving ancestry and this observation; change only LBM5 boot/identity/current runtime network and exact evidence hashes. Preserve pins/config/protected baseline values and the other three entries byte-equivalently.

Bind the new intake and postboot RO evidence explicitly into the final AB physical plan/preconditions. Reuse original strict identity/config/protected/boot/network checks against that new baseline; do not weaken AA or silently substitute new boot into old receipts.

Use the existing pretrial health/current-baseline acquisition. The recorded new boot must remain unchanged and uptime coherent through that acquisition; a further unexpected reboot is a new failure, not automatic baseline refresh.
Keep current postboot address/route observations. Do not write the former indirect route or force old link-local timing merely to match stale runtime artifacts.
Return the exact M5 to the planned RF topology while maintaining power, then record that physical condition before AB RF admission. Ethernet-derived management success is not wireless evidence.
Complete final source/physical-plan independent preflight after the new intake and current bench restoration are bound. Source-only AB review alone does not authorize RF.

private_diagnostic_boundary.owner_interpretation_only: Root reports same boot/uptime356.33 in later read and no explicit reboot cause markers in captured tails. Those private contents/absence claims are not independent evidence in this review.

limits: Local public artifacts only; no hardware, network, credentials, private logs, tests, source edits or Git operations by reviewer.
No cause is assigned to cable movement, power, watchdog, kernel, guard or controller from timing alone.
Current intact config/protected hashes and absent owned RAM support requalification; they do not prove whole firmware identity beyond the existing version/pin/identity gates.
This is a new-condition observation and recommendation, never PASS_PREPROD1, a rescued AA result, or universal zero-touch/performance/production evidence.
